Quiz Category System (formatif/ulangan_harian/uts/uas)
nodes.rationale: Quiz results carry a category (quiz-category attribute / tag / Kategori Kuis column) so they can be weighted into the final grade. Demo pages state ulangan_harian = bobot 3/8 and uts = bobot 2/8 of the final grade; formatif is not weighted. generateReport/updateSummary/getStudentScores group scores by this category.

getForumActivityHistory (referenced in tutorial, not defined in code)
Separate Apps Script Deployment (quota avoidance)
nodes.rationale: Forum & Tugas run as a SEPARATE Apps Script web app deployment to avoid the free Apps Script quota limits. Configured Execute as: Me, Who has access: Anyone, exposed as /exec URL (forum-api-url on the dashboard).

nodes.label: show-after-quiz Grade Transparency
nodes.rationale: Gradebook is always rendered and its visibility is controlled internally by show-after-quiz / show-after-date (grade-hidden property removed). Root cause fixed: the gradebook had no listener for the 'quiz-saved' event in connectedCallback, so _quizCompleted stayed false; now it listens on window for 'quiz-saved' and removes the listener in disconnectedCallback. Goal: grade transparency only after the student submits.

nodes.label: Matching Partial Score (per-pair)
nodes.rationale: Matching questions award per-pair partial credit: earned = round(correctPairs/leftItems.length * points). Example: 4 pairs with points=4, 2 correct => 2 points. Confetti fires only when ALL pairs are correct, so partial success is rewarded without celebrating an incomplete answer.

nodes.label: Per-Choice Image URLs
nodes.rationale: Each answer choice can carry its own image. Format stays backward compatible: a plain string = text only, an object {text, image} = text + image. Helpers _getChoiceText/_getChoiceImage normalize both forms so old question data keeps working.

nodes.label: viewMode student/lecturer
nodes.rationale: view-mode='student' shows read-only grade transparency without the Mode Dosen gear button; view-mode='lecturer' adds the console for configuring weights, manual UTS/UAS input, generating the report, and reloading the roster. Warning: a duplicate view-mode attribute on the same element overwrites the first - use exactly one.

nodes.label: Unified pertemuan-kuis Sheet + best-score upsert
nodes.rationale: All quiz results from every pertemuan/ulangan/UTS/UAS are written to ONE sheet named 'pertemuan-kuis' (Kode Materi column from the explode-quiz tag attribute, defaulting to sheet-name) instead of per-sheet 'X - Kuis' files. Old 'X - Kuis' sheets stay readable for compatibility. Upsert keeps only the BEST score per student+Kode Materi so retakes never damage a student's best result. Columns: Timestamp, Date (heatmap/attendance), Kode Materi, Nama, Skor, Total Soal, Status, Student ID, NIS, Absen, Kelas, Kategori Kuis.

nodes.label: Grade Card Weighting (12.5/37.5/25/25)
nodes.rationale: Nilai Akhir = Kehadiran x 0.125 + Ulangan Harian x 0.375 + UTS x 0.25 + UAS x 0.25, matching generateReport default weights (attendance 1, UH 3, UTS 2, UAS 2 out of 8). Missing UTS/UAS count as 0. Category grouping depends on consistent tag text (e.g. all UH prefixed 'UH') - inconsistency silently skews the report.

nodes.label: Daily Activity Checklist Criteria
nodes.rationale: The attendance-tracker checks 5-6 daily criteria in WIB timezone (reset at midnight): reading >= 3, quiz >= 1, assignment >= 1, download >= 1, forum comment >= 1 (only when forum-api-url is set), total activity >= 8. Thresholds and the totalCriteria constant live in attendance-system.js _getTodayStats() (~line 265); totalCriteria drives the percentage (4/5 = 80%).

nodes.label: Anti-Spam Activity Limits
nodes.rationale: Server-side caps in code.gs saveAttendance(): max 15 reading activities per student per day and max 50 total activities per day, to prevent spam; exceeding returns a skipped status instead of writing a row.

nodes.label: localStorage Cross-Tab Attendance Sync
nodes.rationale: When a quiz finishes, explode-quiz writes a local 'quiz' log to localStorage key a3_attendance_logs via pushLocalLog() and fires the 'a3-activity-logged' event; open dashboard pages refresh via that event and other tabs on the same origin refresh via the browser 'storage' event, so quizzes on separate pages tick the 'Mengerjakan Kuis' criterion without a manual reload. The server sheet remains the source of truth.

nodes.label: DDD Design System (tokens + hax audit)
nodes.rationale: All components inherit DDDSuper and must use DDD CSS custom properties (--ddd-*) for fonts, colors, spacing - never hard-code design values; hax audit verifies compliance and .dddignore excludes build/test files.

nodes.label: haxProperties (HAX authoring contract)
nodes.rationale: Components intended for HAX authoring expose static haxProperties (canScale, canPosition, canEditSource, gizmo, settings); scaffolded with the --writeHaxProperties flag. Without it a component cannot integrate with HAX authoring.

nodes.label: Unbundled Pure JS Principle (no TypeScript)
nodes.rationale: The monorepo is unbundled pure JS/HTML/CSS with no compilation step and ships native ES modules; TypeScript is banned and third-party libraries must be imported from their pre-compiled /dist/ JS builds, never TS source.
